class SharedSendPayload18 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
function sharedSendChild18() { echo "C|"; try { $received = yield new SharedSendCache18(); echo "R|", $received instanceof SharedSendPayload18 ? 1 : 0, "|"; unset($received); echo "D|"; yield 13; echo "L|"; return 23; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function sharedSendMiddle18() { global $child; echo "M|"; try { $result = yield from ($child = sharedSendChild18()); echo "Q|", $result, "|"; return 29; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function sharedSendOuter18() { global $middle; echo "O|"; try { yield from ($middle = sharedSendMiddle18()); echo "Z|"; return 31; } finally { echo "T|"; } }
echo "P|"; $outer = sharedSendOuter18(); $outer->rewind(); echo "H|", $outer->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|";
$snapshot = $middle->send(new SharedSendPayload18()); echo "S|", $snapshot instanceof SharedSendCache18 ? 1 : 0, "|"; unset($snapshot); echo "N|";
$child->next(); echo "V|", $child->current(), "|"; $outer->next(); echo "G|", $outer->getReturn(), "|";
unset($outer, $middle, $child); echo "E";
purpose: One pending parent SEND must retain the ignored API argument only in the child used-yield result slot; direct child next consumes it before real shared return/tails.
